title: Recorded Quest trajectory replay with differential Cartesian tracking in MuJoCo
method_record: docs/teleop/Cơ sở lý thuyết và thuật toán Teleoperation từ Meta Quest 3 sang cánh tay Unitree R1.md

calibration.position_scale_basis: Largest simple 0.1-grid scale that keeps every selected wrist sample inside the URDF-derived conservative shoulder reach bound. A controlled 0.35 follow-up removed shoulder-roll constraint activation but caused a right-arm branch transition with 0.410 m peak error, so it was rejected.

simulation.note: The canonical MuJoCo asset has fixed visual head meshes but no head joints. The runner materializes the two URDF head joints and actuators in resolved_mujoco_model.xml; it does not modify the canonical asset.

transport.basis: 17 ms approximates the fresh-command mean recorded by the T007 source run; source packet timing and recorded command ages are preserved separately.

controller.tuning_basis: Controlled follow-up to t007_mujoco_replay_20260820T121122Z, t007_mujoco_replay_20260820T121523Z, and the ablation t007_mujoco_replay_20260820T122119Z: wrist orientation is a secondary 0.01 task for the 5-DoF arms. Damping 0.1 and acceleration 10 rad/s^2 remove the observed near-singular right-arm oscillation. Scale 0.35 was rejected after a branch transition caused 0.410 m peak error; 0.5x arm feedforward was rejected because it increased constraint activation above 0.5%; linear latency prediction was worse. Full arm feedforward improved the left wrist but worsened right-wrist position and both velocity RMSE values, so the selected hybrid uses pose feedback for both arms and filtered angular-velocity feedforward only for the kinematically separate head.

invalid_if: the source trace hash or selected segment is missing
the resolved MuJoCo model or configuration snapshot is missing
a reported tracking metric includes a deadman-disabled interval
limitations: This is MuJoCo CPU evidence and is not interchangeable with the existing IsaacLab T007 runs.
The head articulation is reconstructed from assets/R1.urdf because the canonical R1 MuJoCo XML contains fixed head visuals only.
The 0.4 spatial scale preserves the recorded path shape and timing but not 1:1 human workspace amplitude.
Collision avoidance, balance, hardware backlash, DDS, and real Quest network execution are outside this replay.
